name: CRediT Matrix
description: CRediT Matrix helps a research team draft the CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) statement for a paper. Co-authors fill in their own rows through a shared link, and their replies are settled in one review. Contributors can be added from an ORCID iD, a DOI or a tenzing sheet. The tool exports a contribution heatmap and the statement as JATS4R XML, CSV, JSON or Markdown. The web app works offline in nine languages. The credit-matrix npm package adds a command-line tool, a credit-matrix web element, and Quarto and MyST plugins.
